name: v0.3.52 — Compact bottom bar, camera capture, fixes
releaseNotes:
• Bottom bar is leaner — only the centre camera is raised/highlighted now (the tabs sit flat), so no more empty space.
• The Add Receipt button moved into that centre camera — tap it to capture a receipt from anywhere.
• In-app web screens (Reports, Stores, Rewards, Guacanomics, GuacWizard) now show a clear status if sign-in hasn't carried over, and their title is readable again.
• Reverted the top-bar logo back to the avocado.
